newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo's Gyll says no plans for P&U post.
newsitem.headline: Volvo's Gyll says no plans for P&U post.

text.p: Volvo Chairman Soren Gyll, who announced on Monday he was leaving his position, said he had no plans to seek the vacant Managing Director's position at pharmaceuticals company Pharmacia & Upjohn.
P&U Managing Director John Zabriskie announced earlier this month he was leaving. Gyll is a member of the P&U board.
Gyll said he was not interested in any managing director's position. "I have left the executive branch...I don't want to be an MD again," he told a news conference.
Zabriskie was replaced temporarily by P&U Chairman Jan Ekberg, who has said he will return to his chairman's position when the MD's post is filled.
